hypothesis: Host fixtures reject every recovery that does not complete one reset read before OFF.
narrative: Host fixtures return the observed partial reset value after the exact write. They require one read before OFF and reject failed reads, missing or incorrect writes, late completion, failed idle checks and failed OFF. The reset write value and all earlier register operations must match the pinned source. Native queue cases cover retained recovery and failure ownership (checks/a733-gpu-backend.c scenario 12 covers the late reset read).
